hints.title: Monotonic Difference Bound
hints.text: If it is possible to form p pairs with maximum difference at most d, it is also possible for any threshold greater than d.

hints.title: Greedy Adjacent Pairing
hints.text: Sort nums. To maximize the number of pairs with difference <= d, greedily match adjacent elements whenever nums[i+1] - nums[i] <= d.

hints.title: Index Jump Logic
hints.text: When a pair (nums[i], nums[i+1]) is chosen, skip both indices (advance by 2); otherwise, advance by 1.

hints.title: Binary Search Threshold Implementation

variables: max_diff: maximum difference between array extremes
complexity.notes: Sorting takes O(n log n); greedy feasibility checks take O(n) per binary search step.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all pair combinations takes exponential time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Sorts nums, binary searches the maximum difference, and checks with greedy adjacent matching.
